query:
SELECT 
  s.id as sponsor_id,
  s.company_name,
  COUNT(m.id) as total_meetings,
  SUM(CASE WHEN m.status IN ('confirmed','suggested') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as published_meetings,
  SUM(CASE WHEN m.is_visible = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as visible_meetings,
  SUM(CASE WHEN m.status IN ('confirmed','suggested') AND m.is_visible = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as portal_visible,
  GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT m.status) as statuses,
  GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT m.is_visible) as visibility_flags
FROM sponsors s
LEFT JOIN meetings m ON m.sponsor_id = s.id
WHERE s.company_name IN ('The Martec', 'Poetry')
GROUP BY s.id, s.company_name;
